posts.cooked: After playing pretty much every MMO there is, I feel confident in stating that Eve has turned into the number one Gank/Greifing MMO online, EVER. Those who defend or deny this are either part of the mega corp Ganking/Greifing crews or just enjoying being a troll. Eve was a "Solo" friendly game but now you can get ganked/griefed even in the beginning areas, with impunity. If you deny this you are just lying to yourself and the rest of the community. Sad.

Mister lvl 0 has spoken.
88 metacritic means nothing.
Worst MMO for 20 years and probably for another 20.

scammed on jita

You can't get ganked or griefed in the beginner areas without someone else breaking the rules. If you have been ganked or griefed in any of the starter or career agent systems, or as a newbro (1> month old) in any of the common SoE epic arc systems, report it to a GM and the gankers/griefers will be swiftly dealt with and you should be compensated for your loss.

EVE Help Center: Rookie Griefing[support.eveonline.com]

The OP clearly didn't play Ultima Online pre-trammel release. The Eve community has it's problems but ganking low value players in High Sec isn't one of them.

Despite the steep learning curve and low retention rate of new players, all I see is new-bro's being helped and actively encouraged to join new player friendly corps.

Trying to 'learn' Eve solo is a BIG ask, even for veteran MMO players.
I highly suggest you watch the youtube series "Worst MMO Ever?" by Josh Strife Hayes, try some of those games out.. Then let us know what you think.
i have been playing for over 1yr and have never got ganked or lost a ship...me lucky so far

its probably ppl joining corps with active war decs then undocking from jita. there are noob traps in Eve. its a learning experience. lots of ppl do recommend joining a corp asap, you just have to make sure that corp can't be wardecced. the game is quite large and there are a lot of corners in highsec that don't get a whole lot of traffic. everyone goes to caldari space because of jita, but there are quieter regions with less ganking.
It not New player friendly one bit

I can think of 7 worse MMOs to date that are far worse and lasted way less as long.
Tera, Aion, Ultima Online, FireFall, World War Z, Allods Online, Defiance.

You don't make it 20 years and call it the worst unless you just don't like math, precision, strategy, and can't handle being destroyed.

Most people can't handle losing things in games and not getting them back like when you play WoW / EQ / LOTRO / ESO etc.

This doesn't make it the worst MMO, it just makes it the most difficult to enjoy MMO, it's pretty much what Eve had always been.

Eve is a wonderful MMO. However, not sure if the game is worth spending $20 a month on. I think $10 - $15 would be appropriate for this type of game. I know you can lower the cost by subscribing longer, but that also takes a large sum of cash to throw into the game. If they got the price back down to $15 a month, I would sign up today.

Yes, there's ganking in EVE. But you were making an argument specifically about new players getting ganked in your posts above. That just isn't the case.
